# Furkan Vijapura

> Senior Mobile Engineer based in India, working across native iOS, cross-platform Flutter,
> and the serverless backends behind them. Over nine years of professional mobile development
> since January 2017, shipping 30+ apps across iOS, watchOS, iPadOS, and Android for consumer
> and enterprise clients, across five companies. Takes mobile products from architecture
> through App Store release, including the backend and the release pipeline. Also builds
> wearable and device integrations, including native iOS integration with Garmin watches
> through the ConnectIQ SDK.

## Verified facts

- Experience: January 2017 to present (9+ years), across AGILE Infoways, Discus Business
  Solutions, WeblineIndia, Ciright Inc., and Wve Labs (current, Senior Mobile Developer, since
  July 2021).
- Eleven apps live on the App Store, seven of them also on Google Play. Every claim below is
  checkable on its own store listing.
  - The Daily Pour (formerly Bottle Raiders): an AI spirits review app that scans bottle labels
    and barcodes. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-daily-pour/id6502606142
  - Ovvy: Real Estate Camera: an AI real estate photography platform.
    https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ovvy-real-estate-camera/id6447063745
  - Puff Count: Quit Vaping Now: a vaping cessation app used by hundreds of thousands.
    https://apps.apple.com/us/app/puff-count-quit-vaping-now/id1488580640
  - The NotME App: a consent verification app.
    https://apps.apple.com/us/app/the-notme-app/id6745784550
  - Unity: The Better Dating App: a dating app built on real places and live activity, with
    real-time presence and map-based discovery.
    https://apps.apple.com/us/app/unity-the-better-dating-app/id6698861488
  - CardWhale: Collect, Track, Grow: a trading card collection tracker with camera cataloguing.
    https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cardwhale-collect-track-grow/id6757435852
  - InHealer: a self-guided app for managing panic symptoms, built with a clinical psychology
    practice. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/inhealer/id6447936654
  - Worldie Draft Futbol: a fantasy soccer draft game for international tournaments.
    https://apps.apple.com/us/app/worldie-draft-futbol/id6749269769
  - Five Star Sitters: an on-call babysitting app for Las Vegas families (US only).
    https://apps.apple.com/us/app/five-star-sitters/id1449806107
  - DSD App, WeblineIndia: an iPad smile-design tool for dentists, built as part of the team.
    https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dsd-app/id6476902245
  - Fast Tract Diet, WeblineIndia: a gut-health tracker with FP-based food scoring.
    https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fast-tract-diet/id1062915865
- Core stack: Swift, SwiftUI, SwiftData, UIKit, Objective-C, Flutter, Dart, Kotlin.
- Wearables and device integration: Garmin ConnectIQ (native iOS side), Strava account linking,
  watchOS.
- Backend and cloud: Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Cloud Functions, Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging),
  AWS Amplify, AWS S3, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Socket.IO, Node.js and Express.
- Payments and monetisation: Stripe, RevenueCat, Braintree, Square In-App Payments.
- Release and tooling: Fastlane, GitHub Actions, Docker, Xcode, Android Studio.
- Certifications: Anthropic "Claude Code in Action" (March 2026), Udemy SwiftUI (January 2025),
  Coursera "iOS App Store & In-App Purchases" (June 2021), Coursera "Programming in Swift 5"
  (June 2021), Udemy "Flutter & Dart" (November 2020), Udemy "Swift and Xcode Development"
  (June 2020), Google Digital Unlocked, IICT certification.
- Education: MCA, Suresh Gyan Vihar University (2020 to 2022); Master of Mobile Application
  Development, Ganpat University (2016 to 2018); BCA, Grow More Group of Institutions (2013 to
  2016).

## Pages

- [Portfolio](https://furkanvijapura.github.io/): full resume, experience timeline, shipped
  apps, services, tech stack, and contact info on a single page.
- [The Daily Pour case study](https://furkanvijapura.github.io/work/the-daily-pour): the
  two-backend sync problem and the REST layer built to solve it.
- [Ovvy case study](https://furkanvijapura.github.io/work/ovvy): offline-first capture and an
  asynchronous AWS processing pipeline.
- [Puff Count case study](https://furkanvijapura.github.io/work/puff-count): dual-series
  charting and a client-side fix for Firebase data-transfer costs.
- [The NotME App case study](https://furkanvijapura.github.io/work/the-notme-app): private
  preference matching and identity-backed consent records.
